status.en: 11 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 56% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 11 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 56 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraq's parliament approved the al-Zaidi cabinet while a curfew was imposed overnight in Kirkuk south of Daquq. The Iraqi bank rejected Treasury allegations after Treasury sanctions were announced, and security forces uncovered a mobile counterfeit currency operation near the Iran border. Iraq will receive its first air-defence system within months and has prioritized completing air-defence capabilities, while Italy prepared to resume military training and intelligence cooperation with Kurdistan. A militia leader warned his forces would fight if Iran faced an existential threat, saying relations with the US would never return to normal. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iraks parlament godkjente al-Zaidi-regjeringen mens et nattlig utehold ble innført i Kirkuk sør for Daquq. Den irakiske banken avviste Treasury-anklager etter at Treasury-sanksjoner ble kunngjort, og sikkerhetsstyrker avdekket en mobil falskmynteoperasjon nær grensen mot Iran. Irak vil motta sitt første luftvernsystem innen måneder og har prioritert å fullføre luftverns­kapasitetene, mens Italia forberedte seg på å gjenoppta militær trening og etterretningssamarbeid med Kurdistan. En militsleder advarte om at hans styrker ville kjempe dersom Iran ble utsatt for en eksistensiell trussel, og sa at forholdet til USA aldri ville bli normalt igjen. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
